name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
summary: Rin'ji, a troll, has lost an axe and been captured in Quel'Danil Lodge, and begs for help to escape. Rin'ji knows that others may not like Rin'ji's kind, but promises something in return and mentions a secret hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.

sections.title: A Plea for Escape
sections.body: Rin'ji is a captive at Quel'Danil Lodge and badly frightened. The axe is gone, and Rin'ji begs any passer-by to help get away. Rin'ji knows many dislike Rin'ji's kind, but offers something for a kind soul who helps, and says a secret lies hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.

sections.title: At the End of the Escape
sections.body: What awaits is a troll tablet covered with strange markings. Nothing about the writing can be made out.

aliases: who is the troll in quel'danil
faq.answer: Rin'ji is a troll who lost an axe and was captured at Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands. Rin'ji speaks of the self in the third person and begs for help to escape.
Rin'ji is held at Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What does Rin'ji offer for help?
faq.answer: Rin'ji has something for those who help, and says a secret is hidden at the Overlook Cliffs.
